  • Method Details

    • append

      public String append(String key, byte[] data, Duration ttl)
      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Append an entry, resetting the journal's inactivity timer atomically.
      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key for the journal
      data - the encoded entry payload
      ttl - how long this entry remains readable; Duration.ZERO stores it without a TTL
      Returns:
      the id of the appended entry, ordered after every id already in the journal

    • readAfter

      public List<RawJournalEntry> readAfter(String key, String afterId)
      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Read entries strictly after the given id.
      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key for the journal
      afterId - the exclusive lower bound cursor
      Returns:
      the entries after the cursor in append order, empty if there are none

    • readLast

      public List<RawJournalEntry> readLast(String key, int count)
      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Read the last count entries in chronological order.
      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key for the journal
      count - the maximum number of entries to return
      Returns:
      up to count of the most recent entries, oldest first

    • complete

      public void complete(String key, Duration retentionTtl)
      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Mark the journal as completed with a retention TTL. Calling on an already-completed journal updates the retention TTL (latest call wins).
      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key for the journal
      retentionTtl - how long the completed journal stays readable; Duration.ZERO retains it without a TTL

      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Returns whether the journal has been marked as completed.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if the journal has been completed; false otherwise

    • delete

      public void delete(String key)
      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Removes the journal and all of its entries. This operation is idempotent — deleting a non-existent journal is a no-op.
      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key for the journal

    • exists

      public boolean exists(String key)
      Description copied from interface: JournalSpi
      Returns whether a live journal exists at the given key.

      A journal is "live" if it was created and has not expired. Completed journals within their retention window still count as existing — they can be attached to and read, even though they no longer accept appends.

      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key
      Returns:
      true if a live journal exists at this key
